QuestInfo.name: The Broken Seal
QuestInfo.0: You discover that one of the seals locking the Black Mage is broken! But you think it can be fixed...
QuestInfo.1: The broken seal looks just like the Seal Stone! Maybe you can use the Seal Stone to fix the broken seal. Go see Athena Pierce.
QuestInfo.2: You tell Athena Pierce about the Black Mage, the broken seal, and your idea with the Seal Stone.

0.0: One of the five seals is indeed broken, and it's totally giving me the heebie-jeebies. I wonder, could we re-seal the Black Mage completely by repairing this seal?
0.1: Shoot, I got it now! This seal looks just like the #bSeal Stone#k!
0.2: If I bring the Seal Stone here, maybe I can fix the seal!

yes.0: I'm sure Athena Pierce will give me her seal stone if my theory is true. I've got to get back to Henesys.

no.0: No, no. That'll never work. Bad, #h0#, bad! Why can't you ever think of good ideas?

1.0: You look alarmed. What did you find at the Temple of Time, #h0#?  \r\n#L0##b(You tell Athena Pierce everything you saw at the temple.)#l\n#k
